newsitem.title: CANADA: Rich Green to be bought by RBC Dominion Securities.
newsitem.headline: Rich Green to be bought by RBC Dominion Securities.

text.p: Richardson Greenshields of Canada will be acquired by Royal Bank of Canada's brokerage arm RBC Dominion Securities for twice book value, sources within Richardson Greenshields said on Thursday.

"There was a board meeting at 12:15 and there is a conference call for all the branches at four o'clock. But it has been announced internally," said a high-placed source inside Richardson Greenshields.
The source said the deal will be done at twice Richardson Greenshields' book value or C$48 per share. This would put a total price on the acquisition of roughly C$480 million.
The takeover will catapult RBC Dominion back into top spot among Canadian brokerages, adding Richardson Greenshields' 610-strong retail sales force to RBC Dominion's 975 sales people.

RBC Dominion lost its title as Canada's biggest brokerage to Bank of Montreal's Nesbitt Thomson in 1994 when Nesbitt bought Burns Fry Inc. The resulting behemoth, with a retail sales staff of 1,268, was named Nesbitt Burns Inc.
Rumors have been swirling for several days that a marriage between the two rival brokers was in the cards.
Richardson Greenshields is one of the last remaining large brokerages independent of the Canadian banks.
-- Sarah Edmonds, Reuters Toronto Bureau (416) 941-8100, E-mail sarah.edmonds@reuters.com
